skill.name: doc-writer
skill.description: Create or update numbered task documents using repository context, a shared template, and established naming rules.
skill.summary: Creates structured task documents from repository plans, templates, and existing documentation.
skill.author: 0xhiroki

content.value_statement: Teams often lose task context when plans, requirements, and validation steps are scattered. This skill creates consistent task documents from repository context and templates.
actual_capabilities: Reads docs/DOC_TEMPLATE.md to follow the required task document structure.
Uses PLAN.md, AGENTS.md, and existing task documents as repository context.
Creates numbered files under docs/planned or docs/completed with the NN-task-name.md format.
Drafts required sections for objectives, dependencies, implementation steps, validation, and completion criteria.
Links to related repository files instead of copying long excerpts.
Records validation commands when file changes require linting or tests.
limitations: Requires the repository to provide the expected docs/DOC_TEMPLATE.md file.
Does not define project strategy without source plans or task context.
May need human review for acceptance criteria and scheduling decisions.
Validator execution depends on the tools configured in the repository.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Engineering Task
use_cases.description: Create a planned task document with clear objectives, dependencies, steps, validation, and completion criteria.

use_cases.title: Update an Existing Task Record
use_cases.description: Refresh a task document so it reflects current repository state, latest decisions, and completed validation work.

use_cases.title: Standardize Documentation Before Review
use_cases.description: Align task notes with the shared template before opening a pull request or handing work to another contributor.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Task Doc
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new planned task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new planned task document for [task name]. Use docs/DOC_TEMPLATE.md and relevant repository context.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh an Existing Task Doc
prompt_templates.scenario: Update a document after requirements or code changed.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update docs/planned/[file name].md using PLAN.md, AGENTS.md, and current repository files. Keep the required template sections.

prompt_templates.title: Document Completion Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a completed task document for [task name]. Include implemented changes, validation commands, completion criteria, and follow-up notes.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile Numbering and Scope
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a larger documentation pass.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review existing docs/planned and docs/completed numbering. Create the next task document for [scope] with unique numbering and repository links.

output_examples.input: Create a planned task document for adding OAuth callback validation.
output_examples.output: A numbered planned task document with objective, dependencies, implementation steps, validation, completion criteria, and repository links.

output_examples.input: Update the completed task document after linting and tests passed.
output_examples.output: A refreshed completed task document that records validation commands, current status, and any remaining follow-up work.

output_examples.input: Prepare documentation for a handoff to another maintainer.
output_examples.output: A template-aligned task document that explains scope, context, next steps, and acceptance criteria for the maintainer.

best_practices: Provide the task name, target directory, and relevant repository files before asking for a new document.
Review generated acceptance criteria against actual project requirements before relying on them.
Run configured markdown linting or tests when documentation changes affect repository workflows.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent missing requirements without project context.
Do not copy large source excerpts into task documents when relative links are enough.
Do not skip numbering checks when creating a new planned or completed task file.

faq.question: What files does this skill use for context?
faq.answer: It uses docs/DOC_TEMPLATE.md, PLAN.md, AGENTS.md, and existing task documents when they are present.

faq.question: Can it create both planned and completed task documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It writes documents under docs/planned or docs/completed according to the requested task status.

faq.question: Does it choose the next task number?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks prior numbering and uses a unique two-digit prefix for new task files.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: It may run configured validators when file changes require them, then records the commands that were executed.

faq.question: Can it replace project planning?
faq.answer: No. It structures known task information, but project owners should provide goals and approve final scope.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
